column1: # Final timing protocol, galaxy (2026-10-26): Ampere Altra 128 cores, every pipeline pinned to cores 0-63 (taskset), one NVIDIA A100 (device 1) for the certa-gpu rows.

# 20,001,073 HG002 reads (single-end, R1) or pairs; SAM to /dev/null; one session; three rounds, tools in turn (paired bwa-mem2 and certa-cpu Kdefault: one run). Build: commit b4c7696 (code of 56e3d69; default output byte-identical to 77b1df2).

# certa-cpu / certa-gpu: CERTA streams its uncertified reads into minibwa, both concurrent (config = CERTA:minibwa threads; single-end minibwa -K 10m; paired: minibwa -K 10m, or its default batch (Kdefault)).
# certa-*-iv: interval mode (--intervals), no fallback. certa-*-tier: certified reads only, not a complete mapping. Script: bench/final_bench.sh (galaxy:~/certa-io, b4c7696).
